plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE in 2x4 timecourse
plan.analytical_narrative:
The question — which genes change in a treatment-specific way across the four time points, beyond the shared time trend — is exactly an interaction question on a 2 (condition) x 4 (time: t0..t3) design with 3 replicates per cell (24 samples in metadata.csv; counts.csv holds 12,000 gene-symbol rows x 25 columns = gene column + 24 sample columns). The primary test is therefore a DESeq2 likelihood ratio test of the full model ~ condition + time + condition:time against the reduced model ~ condition + time, which isolates genes whose time profile differs between the two conditions and discards the shared time trend that the main time effect absorbs. A Wald test on one coefficient cannot answer this because the interaction spans three coefficients (t1, t2, t3 vs t0).

T1S1 does the sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes coloured by condition and by time, sample distance heatmap, library sizes) so that any outlier cell or condition/time confounding is visible before the model runs. T1S2 fits the model and runs the LRT, then extracts and apeglm-shrinks each condition:time coefficient, inspects the p-value histogram, and applies BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05. Counts are gene-level from salmon and already summarised, so tximport cannot run and no length offset is available — the step must state that limitation rather than fabricate one. T1S3 turns the significant interaction genes into interpretable trajectories: per-timepoint log2 fold changes relative to t0 within each condition, clustered into trajectory groups, plus the simple effects in each condition side by side with the interaction contrast, the MA and dispersion diagnostics, and an explicit power statement. With 3 replicates per cell the interaction term — a difference of differences — has notably low power; the plan holds alpha at 0.05 and reports the limit rather than loosening the threshold. T2S1 runs fgsea preranked on the full tested list, ranked by the signed Wald statistic of the largest-magnitude interaction coefficient (a stated choice among the disputed ranking metrics), against the staged human MSigDB Hallmark collection and then GO BP; the Reactome C2 collection the procedure names as the second pass is not present in this environment, so GO BP substitutes and the substitution is reported. Every gene identifier in the input is an HGNC symbol, matching the symbol-space GMTs directly, so mapping loss should be small but must be quantified.

Keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least 3 samples (smallest cell size)
~ condition + time + condition:time with explicit reference levels (condition reference = control arm, time reference = t0)
DESeq2 likelihood ratio test, full ~ condition + time + condition:time vs reduced ~ condition + time; Wald tests on each condition:time coefficient beside it
apeglm shrinkage of each condition:time coefficient; ashr for contrasts that are not a single coefficient
Benjamini-Hochberg with DESeq2 independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected first
fgsea preranked GSEA on the LRT-derived ranking, MSigDB Hallmark then GO BP
Interaction report: simple effects per condition, interaction contrasts, trajectory clusters, MA and dispersion plots, power statement, session info

steps.name: Trajectory clustering and interaction report
steps.question: What are the distinct shapes of the treatment-specific time trajectories, and how confident can we be in them given 3 replicates per design cell?
steps.description: For the genes significant in the T1S2 LRT at padj<0.05, extract the log2 fold change at t1, t2 and t3 relative to t0 within each condition separately, cluster the genes on these six-value profiles (state the clustering method and the number of clusters, chosen by a reported criterion), and report each cluster with its mean trajectory plot and its member genes. Plot normalized counts over time, split by condition, for the top genes of each cluster. Present for every reported gene the three results side by side: the time effect within the reference condition, the time effect within the other condition, and the interaction contrast between them — naming the reference level of each factor beside the table. Include the MA plot and the dispersion plot from the T1S2 fit as fit diagnostics before the gene tables. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap from T1S2: n significant per method and the intersection, treating the intersection as the high-confidence set and the method-unique calls as a labelled secondary set; never present the union as the result. State the design, the formulas, the thresholds, the number of genes tested after filtering, the number significant, the expected power at 3 replicates per cell for an interaction term, and the full reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, gene set collection versions). Fold in the T2S1 enrichment result with its leading-edge genes, the ranking metric, the universe, the size window, and the method-dependence caveat.
steps.context: This is the synthesis step for the research question. The answer is a set of genes with a condition-specific time profile, grouped by trajectory shape, delivered with an honest statement of what a 3-replicate-per-cell interaction test can and cannot detect.
acceptance_criteria: Trajectory clusters reported with the clustering method, the number of clusters, the criterion used to choose it, a mean-trajectory plot per cluster and the member gene list
Per-gene table gives the simple time effect in each condition and the interaction contrast side by side, with both reference levels named
Unshrunken log2FC, apeglm-shrunken log2FC and lfcSE all present in the gene table; ranking and plots use the shrunken value while p-values come from the unshrunken fit
MA plot and dispersion plot included before the gene tables, each with a stated interpretation
DESeq2 vs edgeR significant counts and their intersection reported; intersection labelled high-confidence, method-unique calls labelled secondary, union not presented as the result

An explicit power statement: 3 replicates per condition x time cell, low power for a difference-of-differences term, and the statement that absence from the list is not evidence of no treatment-specific change
Reproducibility record with sessionInfo, package versions, random seeds and gene set collection versions stored alongside the results
constraints: Report trajectory clusters, not a single fold change per gene — one log2FC cannot describe a gene defined by a differing time profile
Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change; keep p-values from the unshrunken fit
Name the reference level of condition and of time beside every coefficient table
Do not loosen or re-tune the padj threshold at the reporting stage
State the enrichment method dependence and present enriched sets as hypotheses
caveats: A gene can enter the significant LRT list through a non-monotonic or transient profile; the trajectory clusters, not the sign of a single coefficient, carry the interpretation
With 8 cells of 3 replicates, cluster boundaries are soft — do not over-interpret the number of clusters
If very few genes reach padj<0.05, report that fact plainly and lean on the ranked enrichment result rather than inflating a short gene list into a narrative

grounding.reason: Timecourse interaction report: trajectory clusters (R-0091@c19e), simple effects beside the interaction contrast (R-0092@bb58), power statement at 3 replicates (R-0094@6849), two-method overlap (R-0042@54e1), fit diagnostics and reproducibility record (R-0087@c53d, R-0086@becf).
